title: Bridging the molecular mechanism and industrial process of zeolite-catalyzed methanol conversion to olefins and ethanol using advanced solid-state NMR spectroscopy
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,6652-6696
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00341E, Review Article
Jing Niu, Xinzhi Ding, Shutao Xu, Yingxu Wei, Zhongmin Liu
This review advances a novel solid-state NMR framework to decode methanol conversion dynamics in zeolites, shedding light on molecular mechanisms while bridging their implications for industrial innovation.
